bio.text: Brian Meyer, a Democrat, represents District 29 in the Iowa House of Representatives; the Iowa Legislature's biography lists Meyer as serving a seventh term.

The biography describes Meyer as a lawyer and former Assistant Iowa Attorney General and Assistant Polk County Attorney, and says Meyer served on the Des Moines City Council for seven years and in the Iowa National Guard.
It lists Dubuque Senior High School, the University of Northern Iowa and Drake University Law School under education, and says Meyer was born in 1973 in Dubuque and lives in Des Moines.
